census_sentinel (in the `gate` phase) compares LIVE computation for the first three census worlds against the committed rows.csv. Astronomy feeds sky, calendar and ephemeris into world generation, so if any of your changes move a census-visible value, that assertion fires and the run is held. Its remedy is a census refresh, not a re-pin.

That path is currently expensive to walk: campaign/the-murrain is deadlocked on exactly this assertion, because their refresh costs 4521 s against a 1650 s refusal ceiling and so cannot deliver. Your situation is not theirs — you register no lab metrics, so your census would be ordinary cost — but if the sentinel fires you will be submitting a census, and it is better to know that before the merge than after.

IF IT COMES BACK GREEN, none of the above matters and you have simply skipped a stage gate successfully. `heavy` also runs on a merge and not on a stage (0426), so census_fixtures_match_a_probe_of_live_seeds sees your astronomy work for the first time too.
